Name: Pokemon Dolls for Custom Furniture

Description:
UNOFFICIAL CONVERSION

I was unable to get in contact with the original author personally to get permission to convert [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2261?tab=description]this mod[/url], so for now it's an unofficial conversion. If they ever contacts me and wants it taken down, I will do so. 

For now, please enjoy a CF version of these adorable pokemon dolls!

Thanks to Solaria for the conversion work on this one!

[u]Installation:[/u]
